meta.title: Traffic Light: minimum revisions before colour is shown
gaps: Enable "Set Minimum revision to show Traffic Light color" and enter the required n value
Assert that the traffic-light colour is hidden before the nth revision and visible after it
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Enable "Set Minimum revision to show Traffic Light color" and enter the required n value; Assert that the traffic-light colour is hidden before the nth revision and visible after it

steps.note: Start the single-stage auction creation flow where traffic-light strategy is configured.
Configure the auction with a traffic-light strategy and a valid colour range.

args.goal: enable "Set Minimum revision to show Traffic Light color" on the auction configuration and enter the required minimum revision value n; stop when the setting is visibly enabled with n shown

steps.note: No catalog step can set this traffic-light minimum-revision option.
Give the event a required title before publishing.
Apply the auction pricing template before adding line items.
Add the product whose price will be revised.
Complete the pricing sheet so the auction can be published.
Invite the QA vendor who will submit and revise the bid.
Confirm the auction reached a real published project page.
Move to the invited vendor session for vendor-side bidding.
Open the auction bid sheet in the supplier portal.
Submit the initial price inside the configured traffic-light range.
Make the first changed-price revision, below the configured threshold when n is greater than one.
Make another changed-price revision toward the nth revision.
Continue the vendor revision sequence so the threshold can be reached if n is four or less.
Return to the buyer session for any available auction-state observation.
Confirm the revision flow did not produce an application error.
